remarks:
The Moose Knuckle: Nearly 20 Acres of Room to Roam

Welcome to The Moose Knuckle, a camp property with plenty of space to spread out. It sits on almost 20 acres, and you'll have plenty to enjoy on day one, plus room to make it your own.

The finished cabin is ready to use right away, so you can start making memories on your first weekend. Just beyond it is a newer second cabin with a recently added deck. The structure is already in place, so you can finish the inside the way you want, whether that's a guest cabin, a bunkhouse, or you could turn it into a truly spectacular living area.

The grounds are made for fun. Cast a line or cool off in the pond, get a game going on the basketball court, or gather in the gazebo for summer cookouts and evenings outside. There's also plenty of open land for trails, hunting, campfires, stargazing, or simply enjoying the quiet.

Coyle Hill State Forest is just down the road, with 2,343 acres of public land for hiking, exploring, and time outdoors. That's a lot of extra room to wander next door.

The Route 17 side of the property also brings in a small amount of extra income ($500/year), which helps with the cost of owning it. The tenants maintain the grounds.

There are two wells on the property: one when you turn in from the Brainard Hill side off to the right, and a septic system believed to have been installed in the early 2000s. Drawings available soon. The other well is located on the Route 17 side near the campers.

There is no electricity at the camp; however, electric poles can be transferred to the property. The line needs to run from the Route 17 side up the hill to access the camp. There are outside circuit breakers and an electric box that could be included with the sale as well.

Whether you're looking for a family camp, a hunting base, or a weekend retreat, Moose Knuckle offers space, recreation, and a setting that's hard to find.

Directions: For GPS, use 6606 Brainard Hill Road, Belfast, NY 14711.
